text:
Ethan C: Heads-up: recruiters reported duplicate interviewer assignments showing up on candidate panels this morning.
Priya N: Which job/requisition?
Ethan C: Backend infra req (REQ-448). Panel shows the same interviewer twice for several slots.
Ben L: I saw two identical entries in the ATS activity log with different event IDs.
Sam P: Any chance of webhook replay? We had a partial outage on the queue yesterday.
ats-webhook-bot: [11:02] webhook delivery retry: event_id=evt_9a3b, original_ts=2123370000, status=delivered
Ethan C: That would fit. Recruiter Bot triggered assignments on the first delivery and again on the retry.
Priya N: This caused confusion for the hiring team during scheduling. Some interviewers declined thinking there was a conflict.
Ben L: Short-term fix: I'll add idempotency on the assignment handler using the ATS event_id as dedupe key.
Sam P: Can we also detect duplicates on the panel level and collapse them so invite emails don't go out twice?
Ben L: Yep. I'll push a small migration to add a unique constraint and a pre-send check to dedupe by `interviewer_id + slot_id`.
Ethan C: Timeline? Interviews start in 48 hours.
Ben L: I can deploy the idempotency check in 2 hours and run a script to dedupe existing duplicated assignments for open requisitions.
Sam P: I'll coordinate with recruiting to hold off any manual reassignments until the script runs.
Recruiter Bot: [11:25] manual trigger: backfill-dedupe-REQ-448 queued by Priya N
Ethan C: Also, can we add a quick note to Recruiting Ops runbook about webhook retries causing duplicate side-effects and the mitigation steps?
Priya N: yes please. Also add a step to check the ATS "delivered_at" header for retries.
Ben L: Added unit tests for event dedupe and deployed to staging. Running backfill now: job=dedupe-2123456789-1
ats-webhook-bot: [12:05] backfill dedupe-2123456789-1 finished: 13 duplicates removed, 0 failures
Sam P: Confirmed invites normalized, no duplicates on the panel.
Ethan C: Thanks — could we add an alert if a single interviewer appears >1x on the same panel in future?
Ben L: Good idea. I'll wire an SLO alert: panel-duplication > 0 triggers a Slack pager to #people-ops.
Priya N: Closing loop. I'll update the runbook and ping hiring managers about the fix.
Ethan C: Thanks team :thumbsup:
